top_categories.workout_context: Race-pace efforts that mimic aQuelle Tour Durban's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before April.
54ft/mi signals a climbing-heavy course. Sustained sub-threshold and threshold work builds the steady power needed without turning the opening climb into the day’s hardest effort.
When someone attacks on paved coastal highway along the Indian Ocean, you have 10 seconds to respond or you're off the back. This builds that response.

Road-specific control matters at aQuelle Tour Durban. Practice on paved coastal highway along the Indian Ocean: use smooth gear and cadence changes, accelerate deliberately out of corners, and settle quickly back into sustainable power for 68 miles.
68 miles on paved coastal highway along the Indian Ocean burns energy faster than the distance suggests. Train the fade resistance now.
At aQuelle Tour Durban, changes in grade or pace can lift effort above threshold before it settles again. Over-unders train that transition while you keep riding.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of aQuelle Tour Durban. Train it until it feels boring.
Varied gradients on paved coastal highway along the Indian Ocean demand climbing versatility. Sit the shallow stuff, stand the steep stuff, switch without thinking.

Steeper ramps, positioning, or pace changes on paved coastal highway along the Indian Ocean can demand short hard efforts. Practice them without compromising the sustained work that defines the course.
Brief efforts above sustainable power can come from grade changes, positioning, or closing a gap at aQuelle Tour Durban. Train them without letting those efforts derail the longer pacing plan.
Endurance with intensity spikes baked in. Exactly what 3,727ft of climbing on paved coastal highway along the Indian Ocean does to your power file on race day.
Double-threshold training builds sustained power with less fatigue. More FTP per hour of training.

race_overlay.nutrition: Use training to rehearse an eating and drinking plan for aQuelle Tour Durban's 68 miles. Start early and use products you tolerate. Use the organizer's current resupply plan for final carry decisions.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on Race Simulation, TT Threshold, and VO2max to prepare you for 68 miles of paved coastal highway along the indian ocean in Durban, KwaZulu-Natal, South Africa.
